audit.whatIsWrong: Three interaction errors. (a) Two strings credited true damage to Tactical Sweep ('W true-damage cone', 'a W true-damage proc'). (b) Adaptive Defenses shields her specifically against your damage type — magic — and was never mentioned before a burst commit. (c) Precision Protocol is an auto-attack reset, so the burst tell is the wind-up, not the Hookshot.
